question: Padma Bhushan awardee Kumari Kamala is an exponent of _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kumari Kamala** was a renowned** Bharatanatyam dancer, choreographer** and** teacher** from India.
 
• Bharatanatyam is one of the **oldest classical dance forms** of India, with its origins in the temples of **Tamil Nadu.**
 
• It is characterized by** intricate footwork, hand gestures, facial expressions **and body movements that convey emotions and tell stories from Indian mythology and folklore.
 
• Vazhuvoor is a style of Bharatanatyam, a classical dance form originated in Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• It is named after the village Vazhuvoor in Tamil Nadu, where the style was developed and promoted by the dance guru Pandanallur Meenakshisundaram Pillai.
